narrative.overview: A centered 800px reading page containing Jiaxin Xu's name, an owner-selected avatar, two biography paragraphs, direct email and GitHub links, three equally weighted publications, compact Education, and a brief Open source paragraph. The full-aspect profile image is 160px wide beside the desktop biography and 96px beside the name on mobile. Papers show full ordered authors, one-sentence descriptions, and all existing resource links. Education uses one Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen heading for master's in Computer Technology (Sep 2025 – Present) and undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Technology (Started 2021). Open source describes verified AOEB contributions after Education. White, dark gray, and blue links keep the interface quiet. Source Sans 3 is the only web font. Authentic 176px paper thumbnails accompany desktop entries; mobile entries use Figure links. The page needs no runtime JavaScript. Fuller scholarly detail responds to the user's request for more substance while preserving the simple personal page.
keyCharacteristics: An owner-selected profile image and current academic context before the papers.
One compact publication list with complete authors, brief descriptions, and direct resources.
Two degree rows under one school heading after Publications.
A concise, evidenced account of personal AOEB code contributions.
Small source-derived desktop thumbnails and text-first mobile entries.
Document-like restraint informed by Jon Barron, Andrej Karpathy, and Xin Zhang's personal homepages.
dos: Keep current master's studies and the advisor in the biography; place undergraduate details in Education.
Preserve authentic paper titles, full author order, venue information, descriptions, and resource URLs.
Use the supplied avatar at its original aspect ratio with neutral alternative text.
Link the short AOEB contribution account to the owner's public commit history.
Keep visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, responsive reflow, and 44px contact/resource targets.
donts: Do not add promotional slogans, hero actions, featured-paper marketing layouts, or colored section bands.
Do not repeat paper and biography facts in separate news, research, project, or contact sections.
Do not add cards, gradients, ornamental motion, or application controls.
Do not claim the supplied avatar is a verified portrait or invent an undergraduate graduation year, a degree abbreviation, achievements, or other unsupported facts.
